Leukotriene A4 (KEGG:C00909), 15(S)-HETE (KEGG:C04742), 5(S)-HETE (KEGG:C04805), and 15-deoxy-delta-12,14-prostaglandin J2 (KEGG:C14717) collectively map to the eicosanoid synthesis pathway.
